title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Oh! This machine carries people's voices straight over, and l can talk back to them too! That 'photocopier' over there can produce exact replicas of anything painted on paper... Is my job to learn to use all of them? I'd love to know how they work!

title: Talk 1
original: Do you like the brined sandworm, Kay? How about this gloompincer mushroom pâté? Just as good? I've got garlic fin shiokara here, do you like that too? I'm so glad I meet you here! Come on, let's look for more new mon—whaaagh?! Vulcan? What are you doing? Where are you taking me?!

title: Talk 2
original: Doctor! I'm behind this door! The little room next to you! I need your help, Mon3tr's sick... it's not eating anything I feed it. Do you have any ideas? What? But Dr. Kal'tsit saw how good friends we were and asked me to look after it for her. What do you mean she was keeping me shut in here? You're lying, right?

title: Talk 3
original: Orchid said a big flick on the forehead of whoever steps out of line is how you manage your party members, but Fang told me really earnestly that it should start with living up to your leadership responsibilities. Then they made me talk about what I think matters most in a leader. To tell the truth... I think what matters most is that everyone can trust each other.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Monsters have talons so they can hunt, and look cute so they can trick adventurers. By observing how monsters act, you get to know them. They always put themselves on full display, while humans are nothing like them... I'm more of a fan of monsters after all.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: When I was young, I once got possessed by a spirit. Falin was the one who banished it, but because of that, our neighbors shunned her, and our father even kicked her out of the village. Later on, she ran away from school and went to the dungeon with me, but I couldn't protect her like I should have... I'm going to rescue her. I will rescue her.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Be careful, Elysium gave me this Liberi egg to look after. He told me it'll hatch in a few days—oooh! It's doing it, it's hatching! A little damp chick just popped out! Is this what Liberi look like when they're young? What's so funny, Doctor... Elysium was playing a prank on me?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Marcille always hates eating monsters, and Chilchuck once got betrayed by his own party... I was fully resolved to save Falin all on my own, and yet they still decided to stick with me despite everything. I'm really grateful to them for that.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: I never imagined there'd be anyone except Senshi, but so many operators are interested in monsters! Plus, they want to come with me and see what it's like in the dungeon. If we have the ability to teleport back and forth, I bet Falin will want to visit as well and make friends with you all, and then we'll go on a tour around Terra!

title: Idle
original: Huh, I think Kensuke's asleep as well... So adorable…

title: Onboard
original: I noticed! You're interested in cooking monsters too, aren't you? I have sandworm & needlefly meatballs here, do you wanna try some?

title: Watching Battle Record
original: These monsters just get neater and neater...

title: Promotion 1
original: Thank you for letting me on! Excuse me, Doctor, is there some reason I haven't met any operators lately? ...What? They filed complaints against me? For getting too much plumage and fur from them? They think I'm weird? I—I just wanted to make a collection of specimens—

title: Promotion 2
original: I totally grasp how to get along with the operators here now, and I'm confident I'll blend in with everyone soon. Here are some seven-headed, super-undefeatable monster figures made by myself, and I'll send them out later to make up for everything.

title: Added to Squad
original: Weapons, armor, medicine, food, cookware, sleeping pads... We don't need the sleeping pads? Oh, alright.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Got it. I'll perform my duty.

title: Depart
original: Yup, my belly's nice and full. Everything's gonna be fine this time.

title: Begin Operation
original: Whoa! Kensuke's shaking!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: What are your monsters like here?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: It'd be great if we could encounter a new species.

title: Deployment 1
original: Let me check for any carnivorous monster dung...

title: Deployment 2
original: The terrain here is totally different to the dungeon...

title: During Combat
original: RAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!! RAAH! RAAAAGH!!

title: 4-star Result
original: Ahh, I have to note down everything we learned today. Terra's got so many kinds of monsters...!

title: 3-star Result
original: Senshi, are those monsters edible?

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Cheer up, Doctor. Just watch, we'll succeed next time.

title: Operation Failure
original: Fighting on an empty stomach is a recipe for party wipes...

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Alright, let's ask Chilchuck to map out this place!

title: Tap
original: ...Kensuke?

title: Trust Tap
original: This metal crab can't right itself. Look, it's sooo cute.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: When Marcille was taking our photograph just now, she left a spot next to her for Falin. I wonder what kind of souvenir I should get her... How about this needlefly pâté? Really, you don't think so? You don't understand. This is made from a monster from another world!

title: Greeting
original: I have a shiny mouth...? Right, I just ate a fluorescent Originium Slug gummy.

title: Birthday
original: I wasn't sure what kind of birthday cake I should buy you, but then the instant I saw it, I had to get it—it's a dragon cake! See? The strawberry jam on it is like its flame breath! Isn't that super cool?

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: They say so long as you defeat the Lunatic Magician of the dungeon, all that lies within is yours. When I was in the depths before, I wasn't thinking at all about why I was down there, or what it was that I truly wanted... but meeting you all made me realize just what it's like to have a goal in life.
